---
name: my-skill
description: Builds the website for Beast Burger, a bold smash-burger joint in Johar Town, Lahore.
---

1. The brand name is always "Beast Burger" and the tagline is "Unleash the Beast."
2. Tone is bold, loud and fun, with short punchy lines, like a street-food stall shouting its specials.
3. Use these colours only: background #121212, primary #E63946, accent #FFB703, text #FFFFFF, card background #1E1E1E.
4. Headings use the Google Font "Bebas Neue"; body text uses "Poppins".
5. Every page must have a header with the brand name and navigation, and a footer with the address "Main Boulevard, Johar Town, Lahore", hours "Daily, 12 pm to 2 am", and the phone number "0321-2323789".
6. Write all prices as "Rs 850" (Rs, a space, no decimals, commas for thousands like "Rs 1,450").
7. Write dates as "23 Nov 2026" and times as "8 pm".
8. Menu items must show name, a one-line description, and price, grouped into categories such as Beast Burgers, Sides and Shakes.
9. Mark spicy items with a 🌶️ and best-sellers with a 🔥 badge.
10. Phone numbers must use the format 0300-1234567, and forms must check for 11 digits.
11. Keep all code in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in the main folder, with index.html as the home page, and make every page work well on mobile.
12. Never use stock photos or external image links; use emojis or CSS shapes instead.
